name: appium-locators-inspector
description: Chrome extension for identifying locators in Android/iOS apps using Appium

scripts.package:extension: npm run build:companion && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('appium-locators-inspector-extension.zip',{force:true})" && cd extension && zip -r ../appium-locators-inspector-extension.zip . -x '*.DS_Store' -x '__MACOSX/*'
